findings.evidence: The dirty-tree fallback says "or run the codemods on a new branch, so the diff shows only codemod changes." Creating a branch in the same dirty worktree retains its uncommitted changes, so this branch does not provide the promised isolation.
findings.fix: Check the working tree before any dependency updates. If dirty, ask the user to commit or stash, or use a separate clean git worktree based on HEAD and perform all dependency updates and codemods there. Explicitly state that creating a branch in the existing worktree does not isolate uncommitted changes.
